title: Elastic–perfectly plastic thick cylinder: collapse pressure
source: Hill, The Mathematical Theory of Plasticity, Oxford 1950, ch. V §2: plane strain von Mises collapse pressure p = (2/√3)σ_y ln(b/a)
requires: implicit (static) J2 plasticity: explicit J2 is in, a collapse load needs the static solver

quantities.quantity: collapse pressure for a = 10, b = 20, σ_y = 250
